_about: Claude's notes for the Dungeon Flow page. The page builds its map from the .cs files (gen.js in the everything-on-trial repo, branch dungeon-flow) and lays these notes over the boxes. Each note is tied to a file, a line range (a = first line, b = last line) and the text of its first line (line), so it finds its box again when code above it moves. t: a short title (at most 6 words); d: one sentence (at most 22 words). A note whose lines changed is a build warning: rewrite or delete it. Unity skips Flow~ (no .meta).
